name: Vantage Data Centers - Power features page (published rack power-density limits)
notes: One of the very few colocation operators that publishes per-rack power-density limits and the cooling method behind each tier. Verbatim: standard data module supports 'an average of 8.3kW of power to each rack'; 'customers have the flexibility to deploy up to 20kW racks with traditional air-cooled technology and more than 50kW racks using liquid to rack cooling solutions'; high-density campus footprints 'up to 300 watts per square foot'; standard data module 'includes 4MW of IT capacity'; annualized PUE under 1.3; N+1 ('5 to make 4' distributed redundant weave); 2.75MW diesel generators with 5,000-gallon belly tanks supporting full IT load for 24 hours; IT capacity 'nearly 1.5GW+ of potential power across North America, EMEA and APAC'. Highlights list '8.3kW to the rack on average, projecting 11kW+ in near future'.
